Hi Ava,

Thanks for the kickoff this morning. Following up with the list we promised to assemble on our side so the Redwood team can start the SSO/SCIM and IP allowlist work: 

- Primary IdP: Okta (tenant: oakridge-prod.okta.com)
- SCIM owner: Samir Rao (samir.rao@oakridgehealth.com)
- Network lead for IP allowlist: network-admin@oakridgehealth.com
- Target cutover window: 2027-01-12 02:00-04:00 PT (low traffic)

We attached our SCIM template and current IP ranges. Also attaching SAML metadata (unfiltered). Can your team confirm the SAML EntityID and ACS endpoints you expect, and whether we should provide SP-initiated or IdP-initiated flows first?

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood create a dedicated service account for API provisioning (least-privilege) and share the provisioning client_id before we send SCIM test users?
2) We will need org-level policies documented for audit (data retention, admin role mapping). Can you confirm Redwood's default admin roles mapping to our Okta groups?

Thanks,
Nadia
Director of IT Operations
Oakridge Health

Attachments: oakridge_scim_template.xlsx, oakridge_saml_metadata.xml, ip-allowlist.csv

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 12:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff - Access handoff for Oakridge prod environment

Hi Nadia — great notes and thanks for the files. Quick confirmation and next steps from our side: 

- We will support SP-initiated SAML for the initial cutover (simpler for canary), and enable IdP-initiated after smoke passes.
- Our SAML SP EntityID: urn:redwood:sp:oakridge:2027 and ACS endpoint: https://oakridge.redwood.app/saml/acs
- We can provision a scoped service account (rbac: scim-provisioner) and will send credentials via our secrets delivery workflow (DocuSign + KMS link) to your security mailbox.

Immediate asks for us before our implementation sprint (we aim to start 2026-12-08):
1) Please add scim-provisioner@oakridgehealth.com as a SCIM service account in Okta with SCIM v2 push enabled for the user schema we discussed.
2) Confirm the IP allowlist CSV has CIDR blocks for both office egress and cloud NAT (we noticed a /24 and one missing cloud NAT entry).
3) Share a point of contact for audit evidence collection (SOC2 evidence collector).

Marissa, Monica — looping you both to coordinate the implementation playbook and the rollout checklist (canary users, smoke tests, rollback steps). I’ll schedule a 30m ops cadence for next week.

— Ava
Ava Chen
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Implementation checklist draft: Oakridge SSO/SCIM/IP

Hi team,

I put together a short implementation checklist for the initial sprint. Attached is a one-pager we can use in the ops channel. Key items below:

- Preflight (Day -7 to -3): validate SCIM schema mapping, upload SAML metadata, confirm service account credentials delivery, confirm IP CIDRs.
- Canary (Day 0): enable SP-initiated SAML for 10 pilot users + SCIM syncing for pilot group; run smoke tests (login, profile sync, role mapping).
- Monitoring (Day 0 to +3): 1m sampling for token latency, auth anomalies, SCIM sync error rate < 0.5%.
- Rollback: disable SP-initiated and revert to test IdP connection within 30 minutes; flush SCIM provisioning queue if role mapping failures exceed threshold.

Open question for Oakridge: what attributes do you map for department->Redwood-admin role? We currently expect group claim mapping to admin/editor/viewer.

Ben — can you confirm the service-account IAM scope: will it need user:write + group:read or additional admin scopes for entitlements?

Marissa
Director, Customer Implementation | Redwood Inference

Attachment: oakridge_onboarding_onepager.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Nadia Patel <nadia@oakridgehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 13:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Implementation checklist draft: Oakridge SSO/SCIM/IP

Marissa — quick answer on IAM scope: the scim-provisioner service account will be created with the following minimal privileges: 
- users:read, users:write (create/update), groups:read, provisioning:execute
- No org-admin scope; we will require Oakridge to approve elevated mappings for any admin assignment via the audit request (DocuSign).

I will provision the account in our staging cluster tomorrow and send the client_id + a short one-time setup guide (we will not share secrets over email).

Also tagging Monica for the audit evidence plan. Monica, can Redwood provide a short template that maps Redwood role -> Okta group claim for SOC2 evidence? Oakridge asked to capture that mapping in their control matrix.

— Ben
Infrastructure PM, Dedicated Deployments | Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Nadia Patel <nadia@oakridgehealth.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>

2) Create the SCIM service account and add scim-provisioner@oakridgehealth.com to the Okta app as a Service Account user.

We will:
- Send provisioning client_id tomorrow (Ben).
- Share the canary runbook and smoke test checklist by Monday 12/06 EOD.

If we hear nothing by Monday EOD we will hold the cutover and run another readiness check.

Regards,
Monica Patel
